reason: 该插件的主要用户面向目的为为 DSH 提供局域网可访问的 Web GUI 与 DeepSeek 余额查询能力：通过 bundle patch 将 Web 服务绑定到 `0.0.0.0` 并新增 `deepseek/balance` RPC；同时依赖 PC 端配置的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 请求官方余额接口返回账户信息。已给出未做鉴权的安全提示，因此风险集中在网络可达与凭证传递链路。

summaries.zh: 该插件将 DSH Web GUI 绑定为局域网可访问，同时新增 `deepseek/balance` RPC，支持通过 PC 端配置的凭证查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。
summaries.en: This plugin enables LAN access for the DSH Web GUI and adds a `deepseek/balance` RPC to retrieve DeepSeek account balance via PC-side credentials.

capabilities: Expose DSH Web GUI on LAN by binding host to 0.0.0.0
Register a `deepseek/balance` Typert remote RPC endpoint
Resolve PC-side `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and call DeepSeek user balance API

reasons.code: Bundle patch changes the webserver host to 0.0.0.0 for LAN access.
README documents a `deepseek/balance` RPC that contacts `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` using PC-side credentials.
Security note states the web carrier has no auth layer, so LAN binding can broaden access by network reachability.
Package manifest declares a DSH bundle with a patch entrypoint, confirming runtime behavior is applied to web profile.
